title: Guestbook
goal: Build a guestbook web app. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Your name", a text input with the placeholder "Message", a button labelled "Sign", and the list of stored entries. Entries are stored on the server, each with a name and a message. Clicking Sign stores an entry and shows it in the list as "name: message", then clears both inputs. Stored entries are shown when the page loads. Entries are kept when the server restarts.
